question: Which of the following countries will host the 2023 AIBA Men's World Boxing Championships?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uzbekistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** 2023 Men's Boxing World Championships** will be held in **Uzbekistan's capital Tashkent**.
 
• **AIBA President Umar Kremlev** confirmed Tashkent as the host city during a visit to Uzbekistan
 
• This is the **22nd edition**
